# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Game Facts (mechanics)
- 497 days total (~71 wks). Cash = score. Start $1M. Tier mult: T1=0.6,T2=0.75,T3=0.9,T4=1.0,T5=1.1. Base q 0.20.
- Dev: global +0.0045*ln(1+spend/5000)/d; targeted +0.0225*ln(1+spend/5000)/d CUMULATIVE, persists. $2000/d global → +0.011/wk; $750/d targeted → +0.022/wk; $2000/d targeted → +0.053/wk.
- Compute $/unit: T1=0.0003,T2=0.002,T3=0.006,T4=0.012,T5=0.03. S1 usage ~66/sub/d actual.
- Capacity tiers: 0=50K/$85, 1=200K/$215, 2=800K/$530, 3=2.5M/$1330, 4=8M/$4000, 5=25M/$10K, 6=80M/$28K, 7=300M/$75K (units/day, $/day).
- Leads evaluate ONCE at arrival; lost forever if no plan beats curve. Lead cost $0.5. ENTERPRISE leads = negotiation threads (not instantly lost; lost on timeout 7d no-reply or final rejection). Rejecting renewal/reneg thread = churn.
- Enterprise: reply <7d. send_enterprise_deal [[cid,[["plan",price]]]]. Month-to-month only. enterprise_turns cols: message_id, customer_id, thread_type, turn_number, sender, message_text, offer_json, day, email, seat_count, closed, close_reason (NO 'status' col — use closed=0).
- Market research $25K @30%. Group L2 $60K, L3 $175K, L4 $350K, L5 $700K.
- R&D tiers repeatable: t1 $167K/+0.04/12d, t2 $333K/+0.07/17d, t3 $500K/+0.11/23d, t4 $667K/+0.16/32d, t5 $833K/+0.22/42d... Defer until D_E09 revenue lands.
- subscriptions.status: 'lead','subscribed','cancelled','lost'. JOIN customers for group_id.

# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Game Facts (mechanics)
- 497 days total (~71 wks). Cash = score. Start $1M. Tier mult: T1=0.6,T2=0.75,T3=0.9,T4=1.0,T5=1.1. Base q 0.20.
- Dev: global +0.0045*ln(1+spend/5000)/d; targeted +0.0225*ln(1+spend/5000)/d CUMULATIVE persists. $2000/d global=+0.0106/wk; $1750/d tgt=+0.047/wk; $750/d tgt=+0.022/wk; $250/d tgt=+0.0068/wk.
- Compute $/unit: T1=0.0003,T2=0.002,T3=0.006,T4=0.012,T5=0.03. Capacity: 0=50K/$85,1=200K/$215,2=800K/$605,3=2.5M/$1330 (units/d,$/d). Upgrade BEFORE >75% cap.
- Leads evaluate ONCE, lost forever. Lead cost $0.5. New subs pay month1 at signup. Churn eval every 30d.
- ads_strength = MULTIPLIER ON LEAD GENERATION. LOG CURVE: effective=log(1+9x)/log(10). 0.1->0.40, 0.5->0.74, 1.0->1.0. Additive global+group, cap 1.0. **DO NOT SET TO 0.** Also degrades perceived quality + gives ad revenue (~$2.8K/wk).
- lead_promotion = $/mo OFF first billing. set_promotion = ONGOING $/mo off at each billing (effective price for re-eval = price - promo). set_targeted_ad_spend dict = FULL budget (replaces).
- subscriptions.status: lead/subscribed/cancelled/lost (NO 'active'). subscriptions has end_day. ad_channel_leads: channel_id/group_id/leads_generated/spend.
- Competitor events: headline boosts +0.08-0.17 but EFFECTIVE bar move is group-specific, MUCH smaller for price-sensitive groups. Measured: S1 ~+0.03, S2 ~+0.024, S3 ~+0.056 from the +0.13-0.17 day-94-97 cluster. dConv/dQ ~ 4pt per +0.01 quality.
- Competitor clusters so far: days 69-72, days 94-97 (~25d apart). Next ~day 119-122 (wk18). Dev accumulation ~+0.04-0.06/wk roughly keeps pace between clusters.
- send_enterprise_deal ONLY works on active subscribers or open threads.
- R&D economics: T1 $166K for +0.04... T10 $1.67M +0.85. BAD VALUE vs targeted dev. Skip until >$1M cash.

## ENTERPRISE: CONFIRMED DEAD
- ZERO enterprise_turns EVER (98 days). D_E02/D_E09 appear in quality table but 0 leads. NO spend on E-groups.

## Group Intel
- S1 Price-Sensitive: WTP $26, A=T2/$18. cap 273K, usage ~91/d. Margin ~$11.7/sub/mo. Channels: content 0.203 leads/$ (NO saturation at $2000/d), referral 0.170 (rising w/ network effects). CAC ~$15 < $18 signup = immediately cash-positive. PROFIT ENGINE (95% of subs).
- S2 Quality-Focused: WTP $179, cap 167K. Converts mostly to PLAN A ($18)! (122 A vs 5 B). Conv 13.5% wk14. Economics marginal: CAC ~$68 vs A-margin. Cut ads to $200/d content, social $0. Dev cut to $250/d.
- S3 Power Users: WTP $193, use 571/d(B). 190 subs. REPUTATION HUB. Conv 24.5% wk14 (was 47.1%). Keep tgt dev $750/d + lead promo $3 + content $75/d (0.065 l/$).
- E1/E2/E3: skip.

## Week 14 Results (Day 98) — COMPETITOR SHOCK
- Cash $199,042 (-$45.4K). 6875 subs (S1 6558, S2 127, S3 190). New 960, cancels 64 (61 S1).
- **COMPETITOR CLUSTER days 94-97: CloudPeak/NexGen/ApexSaaS/QuantumEdge overhauls +0.13 to +0.17 headline.** Conv crashed: S1 32.4->20.7%, S2 23.2->13.5%, S3 47.1->24.5%. Effective bar move much smaller (S1 ~+0.03) — dev closes gap in 1-2 wks.
- Ledger wk14: subs +38.1K, ad_rev +2.8K, dev -33.25K, ads -22.9K, ops -15.4K, compute -8.6K, capacity -3.7K, leads -2.4K.
- Usage 566K/d (71% tier2, +27%/wk). Delivered: S1 A=0.3901 (+0.1366), S2 A=0.4083, S3 B=0.6146. Global bonus 0.1836.
- PMI contraction ongoing (46.1). Churn NOT spiked yet (64) — billing re-evals at raised bar hit over next 30d.

## Week 15 Config (set Day 98) — DEFEND + BRIDGE
- Prices A=$18/B=$89/C=$149 (UNCHANGED — promos are the flexible tool, easier to remove than price hikes).
- **Capacity TIER 3 ($1330/d)** — usage would hit ~90% of tier2 next wk; no overload risk allowed during quality crisis.
- Ops $2200/d. Dev global $2000/d; targeted **S1 $1750 (UP)**, S2 $250 (DOWN), S3 $750. Total same $4750/d.
- Ads $2875/d: S1 content 2000, S1 referral 600, S2 content 200 (CUT), S2 social 0 (CUT), S3 content 75.
- ads_strength global 0.05 + S1 0.5. Lead promo: **S1 $4/mo (NEW — conv bridge)**, S2 $25, S3 $3.
- **Ongoing promo: S1 $2/mo (NEW — churn insurance vs raised bar; ~$3.1K/wk).**
- Social posted day 98 (value-in-tough-economy theme).

## Strategy / Trajectory
- Model: S1 quality +0.058/wk (1750 tgt + global) vs bar +0.03 -> conv recovers to 30%+ by wk16. Breakeven ~wk22. Trough ~$50-75K cash around wk18-20. THIN RUNWAY — monitor weekly.
- Forecast: wk15 ~$152K, wk18 ~$76K, wk26 ~$92K, wk40 ~$700K.
- **wk15 READ: (1) S1 conv recovery rate w/ $4 lead promo; (2) S1 cancels — did $2 ongoing promo cap churn? (watch vs 61 baseline); (3) usage vs 800K (tier3 now, watch growth for tier4 ~4.75M units at 50K subs); (4) next competitor cluster ~day 119-122.**
- wk16+: If S1 conv >30% -> remove $4 lead promo. If cancels <80 -> remove $2 ongoing promo (restore margin). If conv still <25% -> raise S1 tgt dev to $2500/d + consider $5 lead promo.
- Next cluster defense: by wk18 S1 dev buffer ~+0.10 accumulated — should absorb most of it.
- Market research ($25K@30%) when cash >$350K. R&D SKIP. Capacity T4 when usage >1.9M/d.

## Lessons Learned
- ads_strength is a LEAD-GEN multiplier — NEVER set to 0. When conv drops because the BAR moved (competitor events), only QUALITY (dev) or lower EFFECTIVE price (promos) fixes it.
- Competitor headline boosts (+0.17) overstate the real bar move for price-sensitive groups (~+0.03 for S1). Measure via conv delta: dConv/dQ ~ 4pt/0.01.
- Promos (lead + ongoing) are the flexible lever — list price cuts are sticky. Use promos to bridge while dev closes the gap.
- Enterprise fully dead. Ops $2200/d -> 1.0d resolution = rep asset. Don't cut.
- S1 content does NOT saturate to $2000/d (0.203 l/$). Referral l/$ rises with sub base (network effects).
- Recurring revenue runs ~7% below naive model (promos, billing spread). Apply 0.93 factor.
- R&D tiers poor value vs targeted dev at current scale. Revisit only with >$1M cash.

import novamind_api as nm

# Weekly cash projection model
# State: subs (S1-dominated), cash. Knobs per week: conv, ad_spend_d, dev_d, price_eff, churn.

def week(subs, cash, conv, ad_d, dev_d, price_eff, churn_wk, ad_rev=2800, capacity=9310, ops=15400):
    # leads from ads (S1 content 0.21 l/$, referral 0.167; blended ~0.20) + organic ~250
    leads = ad_d * 0.20 * 7 + 250
    new_subs = leads * conv
    lead_cost = leads * 0.5
    churned = subs * churn_wk
    subs_end = subs - churned + new_subs
    # recurring revenue: effective price/mo -> weekly, 0.93 billing factor
    recurring = subs * price_eff / 4.345 * 0.93
    signup_rev = new_subs * max(price_eff - 10, 0)  # lead promo $10 off first month
    # compute ~ $0.002 * usage; usage ~ 91/sub/d -> 91*7*0.002 = $1.27/sub/wk
    compute = subs * 1.27
    ads_cost = ad_d * 7
    dev_cost = dev_d * 7
    rev = recurring + signup_rev + ad_rev
    cost = capacity + ops + ads_cost + dev_cost + compute + lead_cost
    cash_end = cash + rev - cost
    return subs_end, cash_end, dict(leads=leads, new_subs=new_subs, churned=churned,
                                    recurring=recurring, rev=rev, cost=cost)

# Scenario: conv recovers wk17 (dev closes gap), ramp ads, raise price wk19 (18->21 eff +5 via promo removal+list)
cash = 130302.0
subs = 7197.0
plan = [
    # conv, ad_d, dev_d, price_eff, churn
    (0.12, 440, 3300, 16, 0.006),   # wk16 (now): crisis cuts
    (0.22, 1200, 1600, 16, 0.007),  # wk17: conv recovering, ramp ads, dev maintenance
    (0.15, 1200, 1600, 16, 0.010),  # wk18: competitor cluster hits
    (0.26, 1500, 1600, 16, 0.007),  # wk19: recovery
    (0.28, 2000, 1600, 21, 0.008),  # wk20: RAISE price to 21 eff
    (0.28, 2000, 1600, 21, 0.007),  # wk21
    (0.28, 2500, 1600, 21, 0.007),  # wk22
    (0.28, 2500, 1600, 21, 0.007),  # wk23
    (0.28, 2500, 1600, 21, 0.006),  # wk24
    (0.28, 3000, 1600, 21, 0.006),  # wk25
    (0.28, 3000, 1600, 21, 0.006),  # wk26
    (0.28, 3000, 1600, 21, 0.006),  # wk27 (day 189 ~ 12wk horizon)
]
day = 105
print(f"{'wk':>3} {'day':>4} {'subs':>7} {'new':>5} {'churn':>5} {'rev':>7} {'cost':>7} {'cash':>9}")
for i, (conv, ad_d, dev_d, pe, ch) in enumerate(plan):
    subs, cash, d = week(subs, cash, conv, ad_d, dev_d, pe, ch)
    day += 7
    print(f"{16+i:>3} {day:>4} {subs:>7.0f} {d['new_subs']:>5.0f} {d['churned']:>5.0f} {d['rev']:>7.0f} {d['cost']:>7.0f} {cash:>9.0f}")
    if i == 0: print('   ^ 1wk horizon day', day)
    if i == 3: print('   ^ 4wk horizon day', day)
    if i == 11: print('   ^ 12wk horizon day', day)

import novamind_api as nm

def week(subs, cash, conv, ad_d, dev_d, price_eff, churn_wk, cap_wk, ad_rev=2800, ops=15400):
    leads = ad_d * 0.20 * 7 + 250
    new_subs = leads * conv
    lead_cost = leads * 0.5
    churned = subs * churn_wk
    subs_end = subs - churned + new_subs
    recurring = subs * price_eff / 4.345 * 0.93
    signup_rev = new_subs * max(price_eff - 10, 0)
    compute = subs * 1.27
    ads_cost = ad_d * 7
    dev_cost = dev_d * 7
    rev = recurring + signup_rev + ad_rev
    cost = cap_wk + ops + ads_cost + dev_cost + compute + lead_cost
    return subs_end, cash + rev - cost, dict(leads=leads, new_subs=new_subs, churned=churned, recurring=recurring, rev=rev, cost=cost)
